name: A Husband's Revenge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer.  Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge.  If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.

I last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.
narrative.objectives:
Kill Valdred Moray.

Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, good. These hands killed my wife, Deliah. Revenge for her murder was my only care, and you were the instrument of that revenge.

Here, take the ring you returned earlier. Deliah has been dead to me for so long, her ring is a bauble I no longer care to keep. Instead, I will keep these hands as a remembrance of my friend's betrayal.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have those hands, adventurer?

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 14 to 20, 4,840 XP in all.

quests.name: The Dead Fields
quests.objectiveText: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields. When Nightlash appears, kill her. Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Decrepit Ferry
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Decrepit Ferry. Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

quests.name: Rot Hide Clues
quests.objectiveText: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Engraved Ring
quests.objectiveText: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

quests.name: A Husband's Revenge
quests.objectiveText: Kill Valdred Moray. Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
